plan: To maximize profit, I should bid slightly above the average expected bid of others, considering the value range. Given my value of $32, I aim to win at a cost below $32. Assume others bid around halfway, e.g., $24. I'll bid $25. This balances winning chances and profit, as I'll pay the third-highest bid, likely lower than $25.

Given my value of $6, I should bid conservatively to avoid overpaying. Since the prize is worth only $6 to me, bidding above this risks a loss if I win. A bid slightly below $6 could win if others bid very low. I will bid $5 to potentially win at a low cost or lose without any payment, maximizing expected profit by minimizing risk.

With a value of $17, I aim to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while minimizing risk. Bidding too high might lead to a loss if I pay close to my value. A bid around $10-$12 could win if others undervalue, allowing a profit margin if I win by paying a lower third-highest bid.
